name: Kochi-Muziris Biennale
summary: The Kochi-Muziris Biennale is an international exhibition of contemporary art held every two years across Fort Kochi and Mattancherry, founded in 2010 by the Kochi Biennale Foundation. Each edition brings talks, film programmes, workshops and residencies.
highlights: Founded in 2010 by the Kochi Biennale Foundation, a collective of artists
Describes itself as India's first and largest international exhibition of contemporary art
Exhibition every two years across Fort Kochi and Mattancherry
The seventh edition, 2027-28, is curated by Kader Attia
